Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

kwb.smartwater v0.5.0 (2026-10-26)

New function: plot_effect_of_trees()

kwb.smartwater v0.4.0 (2026-10-23)

The default model parameters have been adapted:

Green roof measures - green_roof_ext: bagrov_value is now 0.95 (was 0.65 before) - green_roof_int: bagrov_value is now 3.5 (was 0.75 before)

Tree measures - trees_sm: tree_volume is now 150 (was 200 before) - trees_md: tree_volume is now 700 (was 300 before) - trees_lg: tree_volume is now 2300 (was 400 before)

Infiltration measures - to_swale: - evaporation_factor is now 0.14 (was 0.1 before), - overflow_factor is now 0.0 (was 0.05 before) - to_surf_infil: - evaporation_factor is now 0.33 (was 0.15 before), - overflow_factor is now 0.0 (was 0.15 before) - to_swale_trench: - evaporation_factor is now 0.07 (was 0.08 before), - overflow_factor is now 0.0 (was 0.1 before) - to_tree_pit: - evaporation_factor is now 0.30 (was 0.2 before), - overflow_factor is now 0.0 (was 0.15 before) - to_trench: - evaporation_factor is now 0.0 (was 0.15 before), - overflow_factor is now 0.0 (was 0.15 before)

Retention measure - retention: overflow factor is now 0.6 (was 0.5 before)

kwb.smartwater v0.3.0 (2026-07-31)

In this version,

  • tree measures are considered by increasing the vegetation class,
  • default model parameters can be overridden.

kwb.smartwater v0.2.1

Fix bug in considering existing green roofs for status quo calculation

kwb.smartwater v0.2.0

Changed interface to the plot-related functions, allowing to specify the margins

kwb.smartwater v0.1.0

First version to be used by the Smartwater Web App, developed by Technologiestiftung Berlin

kwb.smartwater 0.0.0.9000

  • Added a NEWS.md file to track changes to the package.
